It was split off and created as an the independent Seal of Solomon with the single class of Collar by Emperor Haile Selassie I in 1930. Order awarded the Emperor and Empress, members of the Imperial Family, Foreign Sovereigns, and a maximum of three ordinary recipients who have rendered exceptionally meritorious services.
